drafts.title: Hypothetical: Reproducibility in Local LLM Testing - Before & After Model Recommendations
drafts.body:
This is a hypothetical discussion regarding reproducibility in local LLM testing. Imagine a scenario comparing two distinct local models (F1). To ensure accurate comparisons, especially when evaluating the impact of model recommendations, meticulous recording of key parameters is essential. This includes the specific model versions used, the exact prompt fed to the models, all generation settings (like temperature, top-p, etc.), and the underlying hardware configuration (F2).

Without this detailed record, replicating a specific output or definitively attributing any observed differences to the model recommendation process itself becomes extremely challenging. The hypothetical scenario emphasizes that no experimental outcomes are currently available (F3). The focus is purely on the foundational requirements for establishing a reproducible testing environment before any recommendations are even considered or evaluated.
drafts.plan: Discuss the importance of recording model versions, prompts, generation settings, and hardware for reproducibility in a hypothetical local LLM testing scenario. Emphasize that no results are available.

drafts.title: Hypothetical Experiment Design: Ensuring Reproducibility for Local LLM Comparisons
drafts.body:
We are exploring a hypothetical experimental setup for local LLMs, focusing on reproducibility. The core idea is to compare two different local models (F1) under controlled conditions. To achieve reliable results, particularly when investigating how model recommendations might influence outcomes, it's crucial to establish a baseline of rigorous data logging. This hypothetical experiment requires documenting the precise model versions, the identical prompt used, all generation parameters (e.g., sampling methods, length constraints), and the hardware specifications (F2).

The goal is to isolate variables effectively. This hypothetical comparison is designed *before* any model recommendations are implemented or tested, highlighting the prerequisite steps. It's important to note that this remains a hypothetical exercise; no actual experimental results or outcomes have been generated or observed (F3). The emphasis is on the methodology needed for a reproducible testing framework.
drafts.plan: Outline a hypothetical experimental approach for local LLM testing, stressing the need to record specific details like model versions, prompts, generation settings, and hardware for reproducibility. State clearly that this is a hypothetical scenario with no actual results.
